summary: E2E testing of SB Tracking — Module Famille (frontend + backend). 13/13 pytest backend tests passed; all required frontend flows passed (hub→famille navigation, seed-demo, members/codes/battery/status render, SOS toast, alerts page + read-all, places CRUD, join valid/invalid). No critical issues found.

issues: Google Maps deprecation warning: google.maps.Marker deprecated, migration to AdvancedMarkerElement recommended (non-blocking, future-proofing)
Bottom 'Vérifiez votre email' banner overlays member list on small viewports — already dismissable; consider hiding it on /famille subpages

critical_code_review_comments: FamilyPage.js polls /family/members + /family/context every 5s and FamilyAlertsPage polls every 8s — fine for demo but consider exponential backoff or websocket subscription to reduce load
FamilyJoinPage: server allows owner to 'join' their own member slot (returns 200). Not a bug for testing but consider business rule: should an owner be prevented from claiming their own invite codes?
family.py share_ping: lat/lng parsed via float(body['lat']) without explicit KeyError handling — currently caught by broad except (returns 400). OK but Pydantic model would be cleaner
MEMBER_COLORS index uses (existing + i) % len(MEMBER_COLORS) on seed and count for add — colors can collide if members are deleted then added; non-critical
test_credentials: famtester@demo.sb / FamTest123! (auto-registered if missing). Secondary user: famjoiner@demo.sb / FamJoin123!
seed_data_creation: POST /family/seed-demo seeds 2 demo members (Maman, Léa école) + 2 places (Maison, École) per circle. Test data prefixed TEST_ cleaned up by test_cleanup test.
